method: Read-only analysis of two retained failing packaged roots (.deszo/tests/p6-build-e2e-6t3Zwi and p6-build-e2e-VoajN1), their Host journals (installation/.deszo-host/operations.ndjson, millisecond epoch 'at' values from one Host clock), durable lifecycle.json, active.json, runner.log and failure records, against lifecycle-host/src/lib.rs, lifecycle-host/src/engine_switch.rs, runtime/runner.mjs, runtime/host/p6Maintenance.mjs and runtime/tests/p6-g0-support.mjs. No production logging was added.

runs.testError: Timed out waiting for the committed Engine B to become ready via autonomous P6 pipeline.
runs.concurrentWith: p6-build-e2e-VoajN1 (started about 55 s earlier; both packaged runs shared the machine)

timeline.detail: Engine A ready (enginePid 9208, Shell 30088); the test then POSTs the test-only p6-activate route and starts a fixed 180000 ms eventually() wait
B staged; trigger to staged about 138 s
Engine A tree (Shell 30088, Engine 9208) ended by the switch
B maintenance candidate: Shell 18776; state.managed inserted under the state lock in spawn_build_with (lib.rs:1638)
maintenance_ready accepted from Engine pid 36616, a child of Shell 18776 (engine_switch.rs:522-531 requires state.managed)
then candidate_alive check reads state.managed (engine_switch.rs:738-746): present and running

timeline.at: between 1793698321516 and 1793698337026; the 180 s deadline fell at about 1793698329200
timeline.detail: the 180 s window expired; the test's finally block called host.stop(), which writes 'shutdown' to the Host stdin (p6-g0-support.mjs:199); Host::run breaks its loop, ends custody, then shutdown_managed() takes state.managed (lib.rs:863 -> 2583) and asks the candidate tree to stop
the switch worker thread finished the 15.5 s package re-verification and committed active.json = B; it does not re-check state.managed or the Host stop request
wait_for_candidate_ready (engine_switch.rs:886-907) found state.managed = None: 'the candidate is not running'; the durable phase stays 'committed' (hold annotates, engine_switch.rs:576-589)

B received maintenance_wait = commit and called engine.source_release: refused 'Lifecycle Host has no managed application' (lib.rs:1890) -> runner.log 'enrollment was refused: source_release_unavailable'

B (pid 36616, same process as the preflight) sent engine.ready; accept_ready found no managed record (lib.rs:2142-2152); the unhandled refusal ended the runner (runner.log stack at runner.mjs ready())
logged at the end of the Host's own shutdown_managed for Shell 18776 (lib.rs:2647)

runs.testError: Timed out waiting for the committed Engine B to become ready via autonomous P6 pipeline.
runs.note: Same chain: commit about 194 s after Engine A became ready; hold 10 ms after commit; B's tree stopped by the Host's own shutdown.

earlierRetainedRuns: p6-build-e2e-3Fd8Vy, 6sggr4, O5w11q, j9CtHN reached engine_switch_verified 116-144 s after Engine A readiness; their test failures were later C-stage fixture errors. The two failing runs needed 188-194 s to commit because the continuity pass added pre-switch source checks and the two runs were concurrent.

answers.1_managedAfterMaintenanceSpawn: Yes. spawn_build_with records state.managed before writing the bootstrap; application_spawned names Shell 18776.
answers.2_managedAtPreflightSuccess: Yes. maintenance_ready refuses without state.managed and verified Shell 18776 / Engine child 36616.
answers.3_managedAtSelectorCommit: Present at the candidate_alive check after the Store boundary; commit() does not consult it; it was absent 12 ms after the commit.
answers.4_removedBeforeNormalStartup: Yes, by the Host's graceful stop, not by a candidate exit.
answers.5_removingCodePath: Host::run (lib.rs:765-863): stdin 'shutdown' -> loop break -> custody.shutdown() -> shutdown_managed() -> shutdown_managed_inner state.managed.take() (lib.rs:2583).
answers.6_bExitedBeforeRemoval: No. Engine B (pid 36616) was alive 3.3 s after the removal and sent readiness.
answers.7_firstFatalError: None before the removal. Afterwards the readiness refusal ended the runner.
answers.8_runningSourceBeforeRegistration: No. The managed record existed from 317.5 s; B's queries came after the 337.0 s commit.
answers.9_sameProcessReused: Yes. Preflight and readiness came from the same Engine pid 36616 under Shell 18776.
answers.10_identityChanged: No. Operation, build, generation and package digest were constant.
answers.11_fixtureLackedStartupData: No for readiness: with only the harness wait corrected (P6-BUILD-UNBLOCK run 1) the same layout reached engine_switch_verified and loaded its enrollment.
answers.12_continuationVsProcessLoss: Process-record loss (from the test-initiated Host stop) caused source_release_unavailable; the readiness refusal, not continuation, ended B.

firstCausalFailure: The packaged test's fixed 180 s readiness wait, measured from the trigger, was shorter than the real trigger-to-commit time (188-194 s under concurrent load). Its timeout ran the finally block, which stopped the Host while the switch worker was between its candidate check and readiness.
rootCause: Test-harness deadline and teardown, not a Rust Host, Shell or Engine startup defect. The Host's 'no managed application' messages are consequences of the test's own Host stop.
hostObservationForReview: The switch worker checks candidate liveness before a 15-19 s package re-verification and does not re-check it, or a pending Host stop, before the commit write. A stop or candidate exit inside that window yields a committed selection whose readiness cannot complete in this Host lifetime. The Store stays guarded until the commit, the candidate never opened the production Store, the durable phase is committed and a restart starts the committed Engine, so no G0 safety invariant is broken. Not changed in this stage.
